_about: G5-crispness-per-dpr. Static computation from maps-site/index.html constants (NZ=4, Z_STREET=11.5, FOOT_R, GEN_SIZE=2048, cityBox/cityMaxZ) and JPEG/pyramid sizes. World px at z4 = 1 CSS px; art spans 2*r*s world px on its long side (cityBox aspect-fit), so texels per CSS px at zoom z = (mx/(2 r s))/2^(z-4); texels per device px divides by DPR. z_native = 4+log2(mx/(2 r s)) is where 1 texel = 1 CSS px. Threshold z for T texels/device px = z_native - log2(DPR) + log2(1/T). cityMaxZ_registered = min(11.5, 4+log2(regMx/(2 r s))) with regMx the w/h literals passed to registerCityOverlay (3072 for both canon plates, 2048 for generated); upscale at cap = DPR * 2^(cap - z_native(source)). Policy scale s shrinks the footprint half-size (tc-4), raising z_native and cap by log2(1/s). No browser run; Leaflet image smoothing and JPEG quality not modelled. This is about RENDERING crispness only; it says nothing about REGISTRATION (where the art sits).

constants.RETINA: !!L.Browser.retina; only used by makeBase/enterChart tile layers (detectRetina, maxNativeZoom-1); cityMaxZ, cityBox and GEN_SIZE ignore DPR

gen_size_dpr_whatif_about: GEN_SIZE scaled to 2048*DPR. Today ensureCityGen registers w:gen.w,h:gen.h (=S), so cityMaxZ rises with S and upscale at the cap stays = DPR (column upscale_with_todays_code); only holding the 2048 literals buys 1 texel/device px at the cap. genCityCanvas draws with absolute px constants (lineWidth=0.8, font='bold 42px Georgia...', 'italic 20px Georgia'), so a bigger S is a different drawing (thinner relative hairlines, smaller relative type), not a supersample; a true supersample needs g.scale() inside the pinned genCityCanvas.
invariant: cityMaxZ(a,reg.w,reg.h) reads the registered dims, so a higher-res source registered at its own dims (pyramid, bigger GEN_SIZE) or a tc-4 scale s raises the cap by exactly the same amount as z_native: upscale at cap stays = DPR (3 on iphone13/landscape) and the soft band below the cap stays log2(DPR) wide (1.585 at DPR 3). Absolute thresholds move; crispness at the deepest zoom does not. Only decoupling the cap from the source (hold the registration literals, or a DPR-aware cap) changes it.

raster_options.option: Serve the full-res canon plate (3914x4200 Epēshu, 4245x3951 Summarch = the z3 pyramid stitched into one JPEG) as the imageOverlay URL, KEEP registerCityOverlay literals w:2863,h:3072 / w:3072,h:2859
raster_options.registration: unchanged: aspect 2863/3072=0.93197 vs 3914/4200=0.93190 (Summarch 1.07450 vs 1.07441) so cityBox does not move; poiRef already uses DETAIL dims 3914x4200 / 4245x3951
raster_options.why_not_tileLayer: pyramid texels per world px = 4200/52 = 80.77 (not a power of two) so an L.tileLayer cannot sit on the world CRS without a custom GridLayer resampler
raster_options.cost: ~2.17 MB -> about 4.7 MB of z3 tiles' worth of JPEG (re-encode size unmeasured); 16.4 MP decode
raster_options.touches: maps-site/art (new plate file) + the URL literal in meshedWorldInit; not genCityCanvas/washMake/sampleCityMask; conflicts with A-U11 acceptance as written (same full file, final shot = R1 at max zoom); changes desktop2x and desktop shots (UG8) -> central re-take

raster_options.option: Same full-res plate, re-registered at its own dims (w:3914,h:4200)
raster_options.note: buys 0.451 more zoom depth, not crispness at the cap (invariant)

raster_options.option: DPR-aware cap: cityMaxZ - log2(DPR) (or partial, e.g. cap at the <0.5 or <0.75 threshold)
raster_options.cost: loses 1.585 levels of depth on iphone13 (1.0 on desktop2x, 1.392 on pixel7); a DPR-dependent maxZoom must not feed back into any seeded output
raster_options.touches: cityMaxZ / worldCityUpdate / flyIntoCity only; not pinned functions; changes reachable zoom per profile (UG8 on desktop2x)

raster_options.option: Two-stage swap for DPR>1: A-U11 preview(720) -> full plate -> full-res plate (R-a) after idle, only when RETINA
raster_options.effect: R-a numbers on DPR>1, desktop (DPR 1) byte-identical
raster_options.touches: must land after A-U11 (Mobile 6) as its own unit; desktop2x shots still change (UG8)

raster_options.effect: see gen_size_dpr_whatif; with todays registration the cap rises and upscale at cap stays = DPR
raster_options.touches: atlas_fn_sha unchanged if only the GEN_SIZE var (declared outside genCityCanvas) changes; cityCanvasSha changes vs B0 on every profile (central re-baseline); a per-DPR S (2048*DPR) makes iphone13/landscape (3), pixel7 (2.625), desktop2x (2) differ -> fails the within-dpr>1 equality check; gates.md UG3 intent ("viewport and DPR must not leak into the seeded city canvas") forbids it outright; 6144^2 = 144 MB RGBA and over the recalled iOS canvas cap

side_facts.flyIntoCity_arrival: flyIntoCity targets max(z, cityMaxZ-0.5): texels/device px at arrival = 2^0.5/DPR = 1.414 (DPR1), 0.707 (2), 0.539 (2.625), 0.471 (3) for every overlay-registered case; with R-a plate held at 3072 registration 0.644 on DPR 3
side_facts.enterChart: modal chart mode serves the full pyramid but caps at RETINA?def.maxz:def.maxz+1 (chart CRS atZoom=maxz=3, 1 texel = 1 CSS px at z3): at the cap 0.5 texel/device px on DPR 1 and 1/DPR on DPR>1 (0.333 on iphone13)
side_facts.base_tiles: z5 atlas tiles carry 2 texels per world px (2x LANCZOS of the 1:1 atlas): below 1 texel/device px at z = 5 - log2(DPR) (3.415 at DPR 3); base fades out from z6.2

medium_vs_registration: Every number here is rendering crispness. None of these raster options moves where the art sits (cityBox placement); a vector city through the same cityBox would be crisp yet misaligned exactly as the raster is.
